title: What an agent is
caption: An agent is a language model that uses tools in a loop and decides for itself how to reach a goal.

agents.definition: Agents are systems where LLMs dynamically direct their own processes and tool usage, keeping control over how they accomplish tasks.

scenes.prompt: Draft the party invitation in 3 lines.

anthropic-definition.description: Agents are systems where LLMs dynamically direct their own processes and tool usage, keeping control over how they accomplish tasks [1].

shorter-form.description: “An LLM agent runs tools in a loop to achieve a goal”, with a stopping condition [1].

willison-agent-definition.title: Willison, I think “agent” may finally have a widely enough agreed upon definition

model-tools-loop.title: Model, tools, loop
model-tools-loop.script: An agent is a language model that uses tools in a loop and decides for itself how to reach a goal. It is not a single chat answer you read and move on from, it is a loop of acting, looking at the result and acting again until it believes it is done.

steers-its-own-steps.title: Steers its own steps
steers-its-own-steps.script: If you have only used a chat tool so far, here is the shift. In a chat you steer every step yourself, because you read each answer and decide what to ask next. An agent steers its own steps, so you cannot assume it takes the steps you would have taken. That is the reason the rest of this Episode is about what you must set up around it.
